## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: sharing the road: pedestrians, bicyclists, motorcyclists and commercial vehicles
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The bicycle hand signals on physical pages 112 and 113 appear only as pictures labeled Stop, Left Turn and Right Turn with two options; the arm positions are not described in the text, so they are not taught and are held as typed debt [A04].
The figure of more than two hundred fifty thousand car and commercial vehicle collisions a year is the manual's own number with no source year, so it is isolated as dynamic [A07].
Physical page 114 is mostly pictures; only its two printed bullets about seeing motorcycles are used [A06].

corpus_stability.reason: The South Carolina Driver's Manual prints a single edition line (Revised 06/2024) on its front cover; its disclaimer says legislative and SCDMV policy changes may make some content out of date until the agency incorporates them, and a possibly newer unlinked upload exists on the issuer site (freshness debt in the run jams), so the corpus is treated as revised at most about once a year, bound to the registered snapshot.

verification_debt.claim_text: Physical pages 112 and 113 show the bicycle hand signals for stop, left turn and right turn (two options) only as pictures; the arm positions need a text source from SCDMV or the statute before they are taught.
